description: Similar compounds search — Find structurally similar molecules for a compound (name=, smiles= or cid=): PubChem 2D similarity search, re-scored with Tanimoto on the PubChem fingerprint and ranked, with formula, molecular weight, XLogP, SMILES, InChIKey and links. Optional threshold= (70-99, default 90) and limit= (1-25, default 10). Source: PubChem (NLM/NCBI). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: chem_similar
